output-buffer.note: a place in memory where printed text waits before it is really sent

fermat.note: for a prime p: the inverse of a is a^(p-2) mod p

segment-tree.note: a structure that answers range questions and allows changes, O(log n) each

fenwick-tree.note: a short structure for prefix sums when the array changes

spanning-tree.note: a set of edges with no cycle that connects all vertices
